text: Father sets down his mug. "It's your sister's birthday, and I've no coin to spare for a present. But you've two hands and a good heart."
"Do a good turn for someone in the village and they'll likely pay you for it. Earn enough, and buy Ros something from Old Garrick's stall."
"I'll do it! I'll get her the best present ever."
"Do I have to? Can't Mother just buy something?"
Father ruffles your hair. "That's my child. Off you go, then."
Father raises an eyebrow. "A gift you earn means more. Go on, before I find you chores instead."
